features.name: Empty list and main-page state
steps: First launch of Aegis
No verification entries in the database
Show the "No entries found" empty state
After adding the first entry the empty state disappears and the verification-card view is shown
After deleting the last entry the empty state returns
features.expected: After deleting the last entry the empty state returns

features.name: Add entry point and the three add methods
steps: Tap the "+" in the bottom-right corner
Expand the three entry points: "Scan QR code / Scan local image / Manual input"
Choose one of them to enter the corresponding flow
Closing the menu restores the original page and creates no entry
features.expected: Closing the menu restores the original page and creates no entry

features.name: Manually create a TOTP entry
steps: Open "Manual input"
Fill in name, issuer, group, notes, and secret
Use the default/selected TOTP parameters
Save
The entry appears in the main list
Re-entering the entry keeps the data consistent
features.expected: Re-entering the entry keeps the data consistent

features.name: Advanced OTP parameter configuration
steps: Expand advanced settings in the new/edit entry screen
Configure parameters such as type, hash function, time step, and digits
Save
The OTP generation logic uses the new parameters
Parameters are preserved when re-entering the edit screen
features.expected: Parameters are preserved when re-entering the edit screen

features.name: TOTP 6-digit code with 30-second cycle refresh
steps: Create a default TOTP entry
The main list shows the current 6-digit code
The circular progress decreases continuously over the current 30-second cycle
When the cycle ends, the code automatically switches to the next one
The user does not need to refresh the page
features.expected: The user does not need to refresh the page

features.name: OTP time-boundary consistency
steps: Repeatedly enter the entry / switch pages within the same 30-second window
The code stays the same
All entries switch together at the time boundary
The countdown stays in sync with code changes, avoiding the case where the code has already updated while the dial still shows the old cycle
features.expected: The countdown stays in sync with code changes, avoiding the case where the code has already updated while the dial still shows the old cycle

features.name: Independent state of multiple OTPs
steps: Create multiple verification entries
Each entry generates its code from its own secret and OTP parameters
Editing, refreshing, or deleting one entry does not affect the others
After a page refresh/restart all entries still exist
features.expected: After a page refresh/restart all entries still exist

features.name: Entry search
steps: Tap search
Enter keywords such as name or issuer
The main list narrows in real time to matching entries
Clearing the search restores the full list
When nothing matches, the correct no-results state is shown instead of the "database is empty" state
features.expected: When nothing matches, the correct no-results state is shown instead of the "database is empty" state

features.name: Search behavior configuration
steps: Change the search matching mode under "Behavior" settings
Return to the main list and search the same keyword
Search results match according to the configured fields
The setting still applies after a restart
features.expected: The setting still applies after a restart

features.name: Multi-dimensional sorting
steps: Open the sort menu
Switch between sort modes such as "Custom / Account A-Z / Account Z-A / Issuer A-Z / Issuer Z-A / Usage count / Last used"
The list order is recalculated immediately
The entry contents themselves are not modified
features.expected: The entry contents themselves are not modified

features.name: Custom sort persistence
steps: Select the "Custom" sort mode
Adjust the user-defined order of entries
Leave the page and return
The order is preserved
After switching to another sort rule and back to Custom, the previous manual order is restored
features.expected: After switching to another sort rule and back to Custom, the previous manual order is restored

features.name: Grouping and multi-select behavior
steps: Assign a group to an entry
Whether several groups can be selected at once depends on behavior settings such as "multi-select grouping"
After changing groups, the organization in the main list updates accordingly
Entries are not duplicated because of group changes
features.expected: Entries are not duplicated because of group changes

features.name: Entry copy interaction
steps: Tap a verification-code entry
Perform the copy according to behavior settings such as "reveal on tap / minimize on copy / copy token to clipboard / haptic feedback"
The clipboard receives the current verification code
Vibration or page minimization occurs when applicable
The OTP data itself is not modified
features.expected: The OTP data itself is not modified

features.name: Entry display and privacy behavior
steps: Enable/disable security and behavior settings such as "reveal on tap"
The verification code is hidden or shown by default
Tapping the entry temporarily reveals the code
If a display timeout is configured, the code is hidden again when it expires
Re-entering the page follows the same rule
features.expected: Re-entering the page follows the same rule

features.name: Appearance and entry visual configuration
steps: Change settings such as theme, dynamic color, language, view mode, icon display, showing the next group early, expiring-code warning, code grouping, and account-name position
Return to the list
All entries are rendered uniformly according to the new configuration
The data content does not change
features.expected: The data content does not change

features.name: Database encryption and unlock
steps: Enable database encryption under "Security"
Set the password/biometric verification requirement
When re-entering the app, verification entries can only be read after passing the corresponding authentication
A failed authentication must not leak keys or verification codes
features.expected: A failed authentication must not leak keys or verification codes

features.name: Screen security
steps: Enable "Screen security"
The app enters a protected state
Screenshots or system-level screen-capture behavior is restricted
Disabling the setting restores normal behavior
The setting persists across restarts
features.expected: The setting persists across restarts

features.name: Import and export lifecycle
steps: Open "Import & Export"
Can import from a file, import from another authenticator, or export the database
A successful import creates the corresponding entries
The export produces data that can be imported again
Repeated imports must not silently corrupt the existing database
features.expected: Repeated imports must not silently corrupt the existing database

features.name: Google Authenticator-compatible export
steps: Select "Google Authenticator export"
Encode Aegis-compatible verification entries into QR-code data
Re-import using a compatible flow
Name, issuer, secret, and OTP parameters stay consistent within the representable range
features.expected: Name, issuer, secret, and OTP parameters stay consistent within the representable range

features.name: Backups and audit log
steps: Configure backup reminder / automatic backup / Android cloud backup
Whether a feature is available depends on the security conditions
After important app events, records are created in the "Audit log"
When there are no events, the "No reported events" empty state is shown
Backup and log state are preserved after re-entering the page
features.expected: Backup and log state are preserved after re-entering the page
